runtime: Java plugin loaded by the Hytale dedicated server (mods/)
distribution: One jar per Hytale server version (takaro-hytale-server-<hytale version>-<version>.jar)

statusDefinitions.live-supported: Implemented in the plugin and proven through Takaro with a real Hytale client.
statusDefinitions.unsupported: Not declared in the Capability Manifest; the plugin answers with a structured 'unsupported' error.

knownGaps: Hytale has no level or skill system the server exposes, so players.progression is not declared
The world map covers only chunks that already exist (explored areas)
player-death names no weapon: Hytale does not report one
The 0.7.7 client sometimes shows 'Lost connection to the server.' instead of a kick or ban reason; the game's own /kick does the same
Each Hytale server update needs a matching plugin build
